title: PRD editing — hotlist & quick todos
content:
Quick scratchpad for the PRD edits and launch follow-ups — messy, timestamps, TODOs. Not a formal doc.

2026-03-11 09:10 — morning capture
- Top priority: finalize PRD language around canary fallback behavior (short paragraph + table). Current wording ambiguous.
- Note: product acceptance criteria must reference perf SLOs (p50 latency <= 120ms for t=32 tokens on dedicated). Add explicit test steps.

Edits to apply (short list):
1) Rewrite 'fallback' section to include: ordering of fallback tiers (same-region compatible model -> cross-region compatible -> smaller-quantized variant). Add example flow.
2) Add rollout checklist item: 'validate KV cache warming script' (ENG-4123).
3) Clarify 'billing implications' line: specify per-token vs per-embedding for rerank pipeline.
4) Add doc note with known limitations for embeddings 8k context model.

Midday notes (2026-03-11 13:05)
- Quick sync with Evan: he will own the cache script test, target EOD.
- Liam to review wording on 'degraded-output handling' by tomorrow morning.
- Slack thread: #launch-readout — flagged by legal on telemetry wording. Need short sentence for privacy: 'no customer prompts are logged without consent' — route to security for sign-off.

Launch checklist (working)
- [ ] PRD final draft to doc owners (Sofia/Evan/Liam)
- [ ] Confluence page linked from PRD (CONFLUENCE-RED-1294)
- [ ] Smoke test plan added (small suite + sample prompts)
- [ ] Canary region defined and capacity reserved (ops follow-up)
- [ ] Rollback/timeout policy documented and shortened wording for engineers

Blockers / open questions
- Legal needs exact telemetry sentence (assigned: Sofia to coordinate)
- Do we include 'auto-quantize' as a recommended default in Optimize? (pros/cons short bullets below)
- Who owns the A/B metric for quality drop detection? (proposal: SRE+Applied ML)

Notes-to-self (fragments)
- Add short table: model variant compatibility matrix (columns: model name, fallback target, quantized allowed?)
- Remember to paste in example curl for 'streaming + function call' into PRD appendix — helps eng onboarding.
- Keep rollout language simple: timeline -> canary -> monitor 24h -> promote (or rollback).

Quick follow-ups (assign and move)
- Evan: attach cache warming logs to JIRA ENG-4123 by COB 3/11.
- Liam: suggested wording edits in GH PR (rw-portal/pull/256) — review by 3/12 morning.
- Legal: pinged Samira (security) for telemetry phrasing.

Rough snippets to copy into PRD later:
- "Fallback ordering: requests first attempt the pinned model variant in-region; if capacity unavailable, route to a compatible variant in the same region; if still unavailable, route to a cross-region compatible variant. Each fallback is accompanied by a short user-facing latency estimate and cost delta."
- "Canary plan: 1% traffic for 6 hours with automated quality checks (per-prompt BLEU-style heuristics + human spot-check). Promote after 24h with no regression alerts."

End-note: hit list to come into final PRD review. This file = ephemeral; clean up and move high-confidence bullets to the Confluence page once Evan/Liam confirm edits.

Random scratch lines (local shorthand)
- TODO: small diagram for routing (ascii?)
- Check with solutions-eng about customer-facing rollout email template
- Add cross-link to 'dedicated autoscale guide' in product docs

-- Sofia
